subject: world_language
concept: Unit review and mastery check for greetings, self-introduction, numbers, colors, family words, and polite words
source_inspiration: original content — cumulative review, not sourced from any single external curriculum

exercise.pictorial: Mixed set of greeting and number-word questions spanning nodes 01-07
exercise.abstract: Mixed color, family-word, and short-exchange questions spanning nodes 01-07

assessment.mastery_threshold: 8/10 correct across mixed question types, plus a passing short spoken/written exchange
misconception_flags: any single-node misconception flag from 01-07 recurring at this stage

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
next_node_on_fail: WORLDLANG.P1.FIRST_WORDS.REVIEW (targeted remediation, routes to specific failed sub-node)
